sop_modules.name: Window Stain/Clear Setup
sop_modules.description: Glass masking (mandatory), floor protection, hardware protection, wall masking for stain and clear coat work on windows.

tasks.name: Glass Masking (Mandatory)
tasks.description: Apply tape and paper/film masking to all window glass panes. Mandatory regardless of application method. Stain on glass is harder to remove than paint.

quality_notes.all: Complete glass coverage with fresh tape. No gaps. Stain bleeds through tape gaps and is very difficult to remove from glass.

tasks.name: Floor Protection Below Window
tasks.description: Set up drop cloths below window work area. Stain drips are especially difficult to clean.

quality_notes.all: Canvas drops below window. Stain drips penetrate — canvas preferred over plastic.

tasks.name: Hardware Protection (Remove or Mask)
tasks.description: Remove or mask window hardware — locks, latches, crank operators. Removal preferred for stain work.

quality_notes.all: Remove hardware when feasible. If masking, complete coverage — stain penetrates hardware finishes.

tasks.name: Wall Masking Around Window
tasks.description: Apply tape and masking paper at window-to-wall edge. Required for spray. Also required when walls are SS_PAINTED_*.

quality_notes.all: Complete tape line around window perimeter. Paper drape for spray.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Glass masking first (mandatory) → Floor protection → Hardware protection → Wall masking (if applicable).

sop_modules.name: Bare Wood Preparation
sop_modules.description: Prepare bare wood window surfaces for staining. Sand to profile (120 then 150 grit), fill defects, grain raise treatment, tack clean.

tasks.name: Inspect Bare Wood Window
tasks.description: Visual inspection of bare wood window surfaces. Check for mill marks, dents, nail holes, and grain consistency.

quality_notes.QT3: Quick scan — obvious defects, mill marks
quality_notes.QT4: Systematic inspection — all visible defects, grain consistency
quality_notes.QT5: Thorough inspection under raking light — every imperfection

tasks.name: Sand Bare Wood (120 Grit)
tasks.description: Initial sanding with 120-grit. Sand WITH grain direction on all window surfaces.

quality_notes.all: Sand with grain. Remove mill marks. Window profiles require hand sanding — no power sander on sash detail.

tasks.name: Sand Bare Wood (150 Grit)
tasks.description: Final prep sanding with 150-grit for smooth stain-ready surface.

quality_notes.all: Uniform 150-grit scratch pattern. Smooth to touch. All 120-grit scratches removed.

tasks.name: Fill Defects (Stainable Wood Filler)
tasks.description: Fill nail holes, dents, and defects with stainable wood filler. NOT regular spackle.

quality_notes.QT3: Fill open nail holes and obvious dents
quality_notes.QT5: Fill every defect. Color-match filler to expected stain color.

tasks.name: Grain Raise Treatment (Waterborne)
tasks.description: Wet-wipe bare wood to raise grain, let dry, re-sand with 220 grit.

applies_when._note: Activated when ANY waterborne product is selected

quality_notes.all: Wet wipe all surfaces. Let dry completely (1-2 hrs). Re-sand 220 grit.

tasks.name: Tack Clean (Prep Complete)
tasks.description: Remove all sanding dust with tack cloth before stain or conditioner.

quality_notes.all: All dust removed. Dust in stain creates visible defects.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Inspect → Sand 120 → Sand 150 → Fill Defects → Grain Raise (conditional) → Tack Clean.

sop_modules.name: Wood Conditioner Application
sop_modules.description: Apply pre-stain wood conditioner to softwood window surfaces. Conditional: softwood + stain + NOT gel stain.

tasks.name: Apply Wood Conditioner
tasks.description: Brush on conditioner liberally. Let penetrate ~15 min.

quality_notes.all: Apply liberally, full coverage. Dwell 15 min.

tasks.name: Wipe Excess Conditioner
tasks.description: Wipe off excess conditioner. Apply stain within 2 hours.

quality_notes.all: Wipe all excess. Surface slightly tacky, not wet. Stain within 2 hours.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Apply conditioner → Wait 15 min → Wipe excess → Stain within 2 hours.

sop_modules.name: Stain Application (Coat 1)
sop_modules.description: Apply first stain coat to window sash and jamb. All methods include wipe step.

tasks.name: Stain Sash Coat 1 — Brush + Wipe
tasks.description: Apply stain to window sash with angled sash brush. Work into profiles. Wipe excess for uniform color.

quality_notes.all: Work stain into sash profiles. Wipe evenly. Maintain wet edge — lap marks in stain are permanent.

tasks.name: Stain Sash Coat 1 — Roll + Wipe
tasks.description: Apply stain to window sash with foam mini roller. Wipe excess.

quality_notes.all: Foam roller for flat jamb areas. Back-brush into sash profiles. Wipe promptly.

tasks.name: Stain Sash Coat 1 — Spray + Wipe
tasks.description: Spray stain onto window sash. Back-brush into profiles. Wipe excess.

quality_notes.all: Spray even coat. Back-brush into crevices. Wipe evenly.

tasks.name: Stain Jamb Coat 1 — Brush + Wipe
tasks.description: Apply stain to extension jamb/reveal with brush. Wipe excess.

quality_notes.all: Brush jamb surfaces. Wipe for even color. Match sash stain color.

tasks.name: Stain Jamb Coat 1 — Spray + Wipe
tasks.description: Spray stain onto extension jamb. Wipe excess.

quality_notes.all: Spray even coat on jamb. Wipe for color control.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Sash first, then jamb. Wipe within dwell time per product instructions.

sop_modules.name: Stain Application (Coat 2)
sop_modules.description: Apply second stain coat for deeper color. Conditional: stain_coats = 2.

tasks.name: Stain Coat 2 — Apply + Wipe (Sash + Jamb)
tasks.description: Apply second stain coat using same method as coat 1. Wipe for color depth control.

quality_notes.all: Same method as coat 1. Second coat builds color. Verify uniformity between sash and jamb.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Same method as coat 1. Second coat for deeper, more uniform color.

sop_modules.name: Stain Dry Verification
sop_modules.description: Verify stain is fully dry before sealer/clear. Conditional: stain applied AND clear coat follows.

tasks.name: Verify Stain Dry
tasks.description: Touch-test stain dryness. Must be completely dry before sealer/clear.

quality_notes.all: Touch test in inconspicuous area. No tackiness. No color transfer.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Wait for full dry time, then verify.

sop_modules.name: Sanding Sealer Application (Coat 1)
sop_modules.description: Apply first coat of sanding sealer. Conditional: sealer_coats >= 1.

tasks.name: Apply Sanding Sealer (Coat 1)
tasks.description: Apply thin, even coat of sanding sealer to sash and jamb.

quality_notes.all: Thin, even coat. Do not pool in profiles.

sop_modules.name: Sealer Interstage + Coat 2
sop_modules.description: Sand first sealer coat and apply second. Conditional: sealer_coats = 2.

tasks.name: Sand Sealer (220 Grit)
tasks.description: Sand first sealer coat with 220-grit. Level surface.

quality_notes.all: Sand entire surface. Do NOT sand through to stain.

tasks.name: Tack Clean Between Sealer Coats
tasks.description: Remove sanding dust before second sealer coat.

quality_notes.all: Complete dust removal.

tasks.name: Apply Sanding Sealer (Coat 2)
tasks.description: Apply second coat of sanding sealer.

quality_notes.all: Thin, even coat. Same technique as coat 1.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Sand sealer → Tack → Apply sealer coat 2.

sop_modules.name: Final Sealer Sand Before Clear
sop_modules.description: Sand final sealer coat before clear topcoat. Conditional: sealer_coats >= 1.

tasks.name: Final Sealer Sand (320 Grit)
tasks.description: Final sand of sealer with 320-grit. Glass-smooth surface for clear.

quality_notes.all: Glass-smooth. Do NOT sand through to stain.

tasks.name: Tack Clean Before Clear Coat
tasks.description: Remove all dust before first clear coat.

quality_notes.all: Meticulous dust removal. Every particle trapped in clear is visible.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Sand 320 → Tack → Ready for clear coat 1.

sop_modules.name: Clear Topcoat Application (Coat 1)
sop_modules.description: Apply first clear topcoat to sash and jamb. Brush or spray.

tasks.name: Clear Coat Sash 1 — Brush
tasks.description: Brush first clear coat on window sash. Thin, even coat with grain. Tip once — do NOT overwork.

quality_notes.all: No drips, sags, or holidays. Tip once with grain. Strain clear before pour.

tasks.name: Clear Coat Sash 1 — Spray
tasks.description: Spray first clear coat on window sash. Consistent distance for uniform mil thickness.

quality_notes.all: No drips, sags, or orange peel. Uniform coverage.

tasks.name: Clear Coat Jamb 1 — Brush
tasks.description: Brush first clear coat on extension jamb.

quality_notes.all: Even coat. Match sash clear thickness.

tasks.name: Clear Coat Jamb 1 — Spray
tasks.description: Spray first clear coat on extension jamb.

quality_notes.all: Uniform coverage on jamb surfaces.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Sash clear first, then jamb clear. CRITICAL: Leave operable sashes ajar during cure.

sop_modules.name: Clear Coat Interstage
sop_modules.description: Sand between clear coats and inspect. Conditional: clear_coats >= 2.

tasks.name: Sand Clear Coat (320-400 Grit)
tasks.description: Sand cured clear with 320 (QT3-QT4) or 400 (QT5). Level surface.

tasks.name: Tack Clean Between Clear Coats
tasks.description: Remove all sanding dust before next clear coat.

quality_notes.all: Meticulous dust removal.

tasks.name: Inspect Clear Coat
tasks.description: Visual inspection of sanded clear before next coat.

quality_notes.QT5: Critical inspection under raking light — zero tolerance

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Sand clear → Tack → Inspect → Apply next clear coat.

sop_modules.name: Clear Topcoat Application (Coat 2)
sop_modules.description: Apply second clear topcoat. Conditional: clear_coats >= 2.

tasks.name: Clear Coat 2 (Sash + Jamb)
tasks.description: Apply second clear topcoat using same method as coat 1.

quality_notes.all: Same technique as coat 1. Faster — consistent substrate.

sop_modules.name: Clear Topcoat Application (Coat 3)
sop_modules.description: Apply third clear topcoat. Conditional: clear_coats = 3.

tasks.name: Clear Coat 3 (Sash + Jamb)
tasks.description: Apply third and final clear topcoat. Maximum film build. Extra care — this is the finish surface.

quality_notes.QT5: Final surface — zero tolerance for defects.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Final clear coat. Followed by MOD_WIST_CLEANUP.

sop_modules.name: Window Stain/Clear Cleanup
sop_modules.description: Protection teardown, glass cleanup, final inspection, touch-up.

tasks.name: Protection Teardown
tasks.description: Remove wall masking, floor drops, sill protection. Glass masking removed separately during glass cleanup.

quality_notes.all: Remove tape carefully — pull at 45 degrees away from fresh clear coat.

tasks.name: Glass Masking Removal and Cleanup
tasks.description: Remove glass masking paper/film. Clean any stain or clear that bled onto glass. Razor scrape if needed after cure.

quality_notes.all: Careful tape removal. Clean glass edges. Razor scrape only after full cure.

tasks.name: Reinstall Hardware
tasks.description: Reinstall removed window hardware after clear coat cure.

quality_notes.all: Reinstall after full cure. Test window operation.

tasks.name: Vacuum Sanding Dust
tasks.description: Vacuum all sanding dust from window area.

quality_notes.all: Thorough vacuum of window work area.

tasks.name: Final Inspection
tasks.description: Final quality check of all stained/clear-coated window surfaces.

quality_notes.QT3: Quick glance — no obvious defects, uniform color
quality_notes.QT4: Systematic scan — uniform color and sheen, no defects
quality_notes.QT5: Critical inspection — zero tolerance, uniform color and sheen

tasks.name: Touch-Up
tasks.description: Address defects from final inspection. Spot sand and recoat.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Remove masking → Glass cleanup → Hardware reinstall → Vacuum → Final inspect → Touch-up.

round_configurations.name: QT3 Stain + Clear (2 Coats Total)
round_configurations.description: Budget: 1 stain + 0 sealer + 1 clear = 2 total coats.
round_configurations.notes: Minimal coat stack. Stain + dry verify + clear. No sealer.

round_configurations.name: QT4 Stain + Sealer + Clear (4 Coats Total)
round_configurations.description: Standard: 1 stain + 1 sealer + 2 clear = 4 total coats.

round_configurations.name: QT5 Stain + 2 Sealer + 3 Clear (6 Coats Total)
round_configurations.description: Premium: 1 stain + 2 sealer + 3 clear = 6 total coats.

round_configurations.name: Stain Only (1-2 Coats)
round_configurations.description: Stain only — no sealer or clear coat.

assumptions.value: All stain application methods include a wipe step — wipe time is built into the stain application rate, not a separate task
assumptions.note: Wipe is integral to stain application.

assumptions.value: Sealer uses same application method as clear coat (application_method_clear drives both sealer and clear)
